params.caption: 🎮 WoW: Forever is getting more quest gold after players hit a cash wall Blizzard plans to add extra gold rewards to high-level quests in World of Warcraft: Forever, since players at level 60 don't get the extra money they expected. Instead of bringing back the old XP-to-gold conversion, the developers are leaning on buffs to fix the economy. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 14:41 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer #WorldOfWarcraft #Blizzard #GamingNews
